frontend: Dolphin 2606a (Dolphin.app), isolated user folder (-u), batch mode (-b), input from a TAS movie (-m)
input: work/standalone/tools/gen_dtm.py .dtm, one GC pad; Dolphin stopped with SIGINT ~100 s in

layout.save_dir: <user>/GC/<region>/Card A/ (GCI folder, the default for slot A)
layout.name: <maker>-<game code>-<card file name>.gci; this game names its card file KA030621_0100_T030529_2154 (a build stamp), so the .gci name carries no title
layout.other: GC/SRAM.raw: emulated IPL SRAM, not a game save

note: The game created its file on its own at boot: 'Creating Kirby Air Ride data file (1 file and 4 blocks are required)' (proof.png, frame 120 of Dolphin's frame dump); the movie then carried on into an Air Ride race and paused it. 32832 bytes = 64-byte GCI header + 4 x 8 KiB blocks. Same placeholder.txt trick as Mario Kart DD so the normal Card A folder is used.
